cases.case_name: Crescent Educational & Charitable Trust Vs ACIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ye ek stone-crushing firm ka case tha. Department ne Rs.1 crore ka addition Section 68 (jo unexplained credits ka section hai) ke andar kiya aur saath hi Rs.94.86 lakh ki expenses bhi disallow kar di. Sab kuch AY 2018-19 ka tha.
cases.issue: Kya Section 68 ke andar ki addition aur expense disallowance justified thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki Section 68 ki Rs.1 crore ki addition aur expenses disallowance dono delete kiye jaate hain. Sahi tarah se explain kar diya gaya tha aur department ka action justified nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke bank credits ya expenses pe addition ho, to proper documentation se sab clear kar do – jaise bank statements aur expense bills dikhana mat bhoolo.

cases.case_name: SR Blue Metals Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: SR Blue Metals naam ki company ka case tha. Department ne Rs.32.56 lakh commission, Rs.1 crore loan aur Rs.62.30 lakh lorry tips ko expenses me allow nahi kiya tha. Sab additions AY 2023-24 ka tha.
cases.issue: Kya commission, loan aur lorry tips ka expense sahi tha ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki ye sab expenses allow kiye jaate hain, department ki disallowance galat thi. Company ne sab details aur evidence de diye the.
cases.takeaway: Jab aap koi expense claim karo, uske support me pura record aur payment details sambhal ke rakho, especially commission aur transport-related ka.

cases.facts: Ek doctor apni professional income par presumptive taxation Section 44ADA (jo professionals ke liye hai) claim kar raha tha. Department ne kuch aur additions kar diye the lekin wo doctor ne pursue nahi kiye.
cases.issue: Professional income ka 50% presumptive assess karna sahi tha ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne allow kiya ki saari professional receipts pe 50% ko hi income maana jaaye. Baaki additions pe kuch nahi bola kyunki applicant ne wo ground press nahi kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap professional ho (doctor, CA, etc.) to Section 44ADA ke tahat simple 50% income maan sakte ho, par receipts ki sahi calculation aur evidence rakho.

cases.case_name: IL & FS Pradip Refinery Water Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ek company ka reassessment AY 2015-16 ke liye Department ne 31.07.2022 ko shuru kiya Section 148 (jo reassessment ka notice hota hai) ke under. Issue yahi tha ki notice time-barred hai ya nahi.
cases.issue: Kya Section 148 ka notice time-barred tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki ye notice limit se bahar tha, isliye reassessment pura radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Reassessment ke notice ki date check karo – agar ek limit ke baad aaye to turant challenge karo.

cases.facts: Yahaan cash deposit addition aur penalty Section 271(1)(c) par baat ho rahi thi. Department ne cash deposits ko taxable maana tha aur penalty lagayi thi par lower authority ne ye sab hata diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya cash deposit addition aur penalty sahi thi ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne Revenue ki appeal dismiss kar di. Addition aur penalty dono hata di gayi, toh assessee ko relief mil gaya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap par cash deposit ka addition ya penalty lage, to ache se batao paise ka source legit hai. Agar proof ho to ITAT tak relief mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Rekha Corporation Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Rekha Corporation Private Limited ka case tha. Department ne ₹2.38 crore unsecured loans pe Section 68 (jo unexplained credits ke liye hai) ka addition kiya tha, aur PF/ESI ka ₹1,00,268 ka disallowance bhi kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya Section 68 ke andar ka loan addition aur PF/ESI disallowance justified the?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 68 ka addition hata diya lekin PF/ESI disallowance ko maintain kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar unsecured loan credible dokument se dikh jaye to Section 68 ka addition nahi banega. Lekin PF/ESI timely deposit na ho to disallowance ho jayega – to usmein der mat karo.

cases.case_name: Crescent Educational & Charitable Trust Vs ACIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ek stone-crushing firm ka case tha. Department ne Rs.1 crore section 68 ke andar add kiya tha aur Rs.94.86 lakh ka expense disallow kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya section 68 ki addition aur expense disallowance sahi thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne dono additions hata diye. Court ko evidence theek laga aur department ka view nahi maana.
cases.takeaway: Agar section 68 ka notice aaye to proper evidence aur explanation bank statement ya party confirmation ke sath lagana zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: SR Blue Metals Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ek stone-crushing firm ka case tha. Rs.32.56 lakh commission, Rs.1 crore loan aur Rs.62.30 lakh lorry tips department ne add kar diye the.
cases.issue: Kya commission, loan aur lorry tips ki additions justified thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne sabhi additions hata di. Court ne assessee ke evidence ko sahi maana.
cases.takeaway: Jitne bhi kharche ho, uska paper kaam court ke samne rakhna chahiye - jaise bills, confirmations ya receipts.

cases.facts: Doctor ki professional income ka case tha. Doctor ne 50% income pe tax lagaya. Baaki grounds unhone press nahi kiye.
cases.issue: Kya 50% professional receipts pe section 44ADA me tax lagana theek hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha ki 50% professional receipts ko hi income maana jayega. Court ne baaki appeals pe kuch nahi bola kyunki woh press hi nahi ki gayi thi.
cases.takeaway: Doctors ya professionals section 44ADA use karte waqt total receipts ka 50% hi income maane, baki record ki zaroorat nahi padti.

cases.case_name: IL & FS Pradip Refinery Water Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Company ko Section 148 ka notice mila for AY 2015-16. Ye notice 31.07.2022 ko issue hua tha.
cases.issue: Kya 31.07.2022 ko diya gaya notice time-barred hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne notice ko time-barred maana aur pura reassessment radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar reassessment ka notice assessment year ke baad zyada late aata hai, to uska limitation zaroor check karo.

cases.facts: Assessee ne cash deposit kiya tha, department ne addition ki thi aur penalty bhi lagayi thi. Revenue appeal leke aaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya cash deposit addition delete karne aur penalty hatane ka decision sahi tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne Revenue ki appeal kharij kar di. Addition aur penalty dono delete rehne di.
cases.takeaway: Agar cash deposit genuine ho aur document diye ho to penalty nahi lagti. Appeal me bhi relief mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Rekha Corporation Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Company ke upar ₹2.38 crore ka Section 68 addition tha jo unsecured loans ka tha. ₹1 lakh se upar ka PF/ESI disallowance bhi tha.
cases.issue: Kya Section 68 aur PF/ESI disallowance sahi tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 68 ka addition hata diya magar PF/ESI ka disallowance rakha.
cases.takeaway: Unsecured loan ka pura documentation hona chahiye. PF/ESI ki late payment par allowance nahi milegi.

cases.issue: CIT(A) ne ex parte order pass kiya bina assessee ki baat sune.
cases.held: ITAT ne order set aside kar diya aur appeal wapas bhej di fresh hearing ke liye, taki dono parties properly sun sake.
cases.takeaway: Agar kisi order mein bina sunwayi ex parte decide ho jaye to uske khilaf appeal karo - proper hearing ka right hai.

cases.case_name: Harsh Jindal Pranshu Goel Vs ITO
cases.issue: GST portal se bogus purchase ka data milne par reopening kiya gaya aur issue merits par CIT(A) ko bheja gaya.
cases.held: ITAT ne mana ki GST data reopening ke liye kaafi hai, lekin merits par CIT(A) decide karega.
cases.takeaway: Agar GST portal par aapka transaction suspicious dikhe to reopening ho sakta hai, isliye purchase evidence strong rakhna chahiye.

cases.issue: CIT(A) ne additional evidence allow kiya lekin AO ki report ka intezaar nahi kiya, seedha order pass kar diya.
cases.held: ITAT ne addition restore kar diya, keh diya ki AO ki remand report ke bina order nahi pass ho sakta jab naye evidence aaye.
cases.takeaway: Agar case mein naya evidence adduce karo to AO ki remand report zarur aani chahiye, bina uske order galat maana ja sakta hai.

cases.case_name: India Kawasaki Motors Private Limited Vs DCIT
cases.issue: Section 68 ke tahat trade payables ko bogus bolke ₹1.5 crore add kiya gaya tha.
cases.held: ITAT ne dekha ki payables genuine trade transactions the, isliye Section 68 apply nahi hoga aur addition delete kar di.
cases.takeaway: Aapke trade payables genuine business transactions proof ho jaayein, to Section 68 ki addition nahi ruk sakti.

cases.case_name: Underwater Services Company Ltd. Vs DCIT
cases.issue: Related party ko charter hire payment lower than market rate par diya, Revenue ne disallow kiya tha aur addition 153A mein ki thi.
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki comparable rates se kam charge kiya gaya aur records mein incriminating material nahi tha, isliye addition delete ho gayi.
cases.takeaway: Related party transactions ka market comparability proof ho to TP aur 153A dono mein relief mil sakta hai, records proper rakhna zaruri hai.

cases.issue: GST registration retrospectively cancel kar diya bina proper notice ya SCN mein retrospective mention kiye.
cases.held: High Court ne retrospective GST registration cancellation ko quash kar diya, lekin fresh SCN jane diya.
cases.takeaway: Aapka GST registration bina clear notice ya SCN ke retrospectively cancel ho to High Court jane ka option hai, process ki proper compliance hona zaruri hai.
